note: clean after the five defects below were fixed during the thin smoke

defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.symptom: process core-dumped; parent episodes truncated after 1-2 decisions
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.cause: env.clone() copies the Python wrapper but both wrappers address the same native libcg.so state
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.fix: abandoned forward simulation; search runs at depth 0 (probe P10)

defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.symptom: TypeError on every game; 0 of 8 completed
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.cause: sorted() over card ids where some are None

defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.symptom: TypeError AFTER the episode ran, and the except-block then overwrote the real statuses with ERROR - masking the true outcome of every game it touched
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.cause: rewards are None when an episode ends abnormally
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.fix: compute outcome only when both rewards exist; never overwrite observed statuses

defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.symptom: AttributeError on the first decision of every game, visible only as engine status ERROR
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.cause: empty bench/active slots arrive as None entries, not as absent entries
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.fix: filter None slots in every zone reader

defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.symptom: 249 of 266 searches aborted before scoring anything
defects_found_by_the_thin_smoke.cause: the per-decision node cap was tested against a GLOBAL counter, so the budget was exhausted once for the whole run

lesson: three of the five defects were invisible as errors: the engine reported them only as an agent status of ERROR, or my own error handling overwrote the evidence. Capturing tracebacks inside the agent callback is what made them diagnosable.
